connectors.name: Fonteva
connectors.description: Fonteva AMS connector: syncs Salesforce-native OrderApi__* + EventApi__* association-management objects (commerce, membership, events, payments, badges, catalog) via FDService Apex REST + the Salesforce platform REST API. Extends SalesforceConnector.

connectors.name: GrowthZone
connectors.description: GrowthZone Association Management System (AMS) connector — syncs contacts, memberships, groups, events, store orders, and certifications via GrowthZone REST API with OAuth2 Bearer token authentication.

connectors.name: iMIS
connectors.description: iMIS EMS (Advanced Solutions International) REST API connector for associations and nonprofits. Supports parties, memberships, events, fundraising, invoicing, and commerce via iMIS REST API with OAuth2 password-grant Bearer token authentication.

connectors.name: MemberSuite
connectors.description: MemberSuite AMS connector — syncs members, organizations, memberships, chapters, events, registrations, orders, and certifications via MemberSuite REST API v2.

connectors.name: NetForum Enterprise
connectors.description: NetForum Enterprise integration connector for MemberJunction

connectors.name: Nimble AMS
connectors.description: Nimble AMS connector — Salesforce-native AMS; data lives as SF sObjects (standard + NU__ managed-package customs). Surfaces: Nimble Fuse (NUINT inbound/outbound), Salesforce REST (sObject CRUD, SOQL, describe), and NAMS LMS REST.

connectors.name: Novi AMS
connectors.description: Novi AMS connector — syncs members, events, ecommerce, custom fields, webhooks, blogs, site content, NPS surveys, and catalog items via the Novi REST API (HTTP Basic with raw API key, per-tenant base URL https://www.<assoc>.org/api/).

connectors.name: Rhythm Software
connectors.description: Rhythm Software AMS connector — syncs contacts, organizations, memberships, committees, events, certifications, finance, commerce, fundraising, awards, accreditation, sponsorship and submissions via the Rhythm REST API (15 per-module OpenAPI specs).

connectors.name: Wild Apricot
connectors.description: Wild Apricot membership management platform connector — syncs contacts, events, registrations, finances, and store data via the Admin API v2.3.

connectors.name: blackbaud
connectors.description: Blackbaud SKY API connector for Raiser's Edge NXT (nonprofit CRM): Constituent, Gift, Fundraising, Prospect/Opportunity. OAuth2 auth-code + subscription-key header. Other SKY API families out of scope -- see Configuration.OutOfScopeObjectFamilies.

connectors.name: HubSpot
connectors.description: HubSpot CRM connector for MemberJunction — sync contacts, companies, deals, and activities, with the full curated object catalog.

connectors.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Dataverse)
connectors.description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Dataverse Web API (OData v4) connector for CE/model-driven app tables. OAuth2 client credentials (Entra ID); per-environment base URL; runtime EntityDefinitions discovery; change-tracking incremental; full CRUD.

connectors.name: Neon CRM
connectors.description: Neon CRM (Neon One) connector — syncs accounts, donations, memberships, events, registrations, campaigns, activities, grants, orders, payments, pledges, volunteers, and custom objects via the Neon REST API v2 (HTTP Basic auth).

connectors.name: Salesforce
connectors.description: Salesforce REST connector: syncs CRM SObjects (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case, Campaign, Task, Event, User) via SOQL watermark incremental sync; CRUD for most objects; custom __c discovered at runtime; OAuth2 JWT/Client Credentials.

connectors.name: Cvent
connectors.description: Cvent event management platform connector. Syncs events, contacts, attendees, sessions, speakers, exhibitors, housing, surveys, RFPs, webcasts, and related objects via the Cvent Platform REST API (OAuth 2.0 client credentials).

connectors.name: eventbrite
connectors.description: Events, ticketing, registration, and event-management platform. REST API v3 for managing events, attendees, orders, ticket classes, venues, and related event data with OAuth2 bearer-token authentication.

connectors.name: OpenWater
connectors.description: OpenWater awards/grants/abstracts/fellowship platform connector — pull-centric sync of programs, applications, users, invoices, judges, rounds and nested review objects via the OpenWater Public API v2 (REST, ClientKey + ApiKey headers).

connectors.name: PheedLoop
connectors.description: PheedLoop event-management connector — syncs attendees, events, sessions, speakers, exhibitors, sponsors, registrations, memberships and 20+ objects via PheedLoop REST API v3 (dual API-key + API-secret headers, org-scoped URL paths).

connectors.name: NetSuite
connectors.description: Oracle NetSuite ERP/CRM connector: SuiteTalk REST Record Service (CRUD) + SuiteQL reads across standard and custom record types; incremental via lastModifiedDate; OAuth 1.0a TBA / OAuth 2.0; per-account host; runtime metadata-catalog discovery.

connectors.name: stripe
connectors.description: Stripe payments, billing, and Connect platform API connector (REST, secret-key bearer auth, cursor pagination, form-urlencoded writes).

connectors.name: Path LMS
connectors.description: Path LMS (Blue Sky eLearn) Reporting API connector — pull-only GraphQL analytics over 16 report query surfaces. Two-step bearer auth (applicationId + applicationSecret then 12-hour JWT); no writes. All data via POST to the single GraphQL endpoint.

connectors.name: magnetmail
connectors.description: Higher Logic Marketing Enterprise (formerly Real Magnet/MagnetMail) — legacy SOAP/XML email-marketing platform (mmapi.asmx, 55 ops): recipients, groups, messages, tracking, unsubscribes, bulk-CSV uploads. Two-step session-token auth. No delete op exists.

connectors.name: PropFuel
connectors.description: PropFuel AI-powered member insights and engagement platform — data export file-feed integration. Retrieves hourly JSON files via list/download/ack endpoints.

connectors.name: Hivebrite
connectors.description: Hivebrite community management platform connector — syncs users, companies, events, memberships, donations, groups, and 40+ other objects via Hivebrite Admin API (v1/v2/v3) with OAuth2 password grant authentication.

connectors.name: ORCID
connectors.description: ORCID Public API v3.0 read-only connector. Resolves researcher iD universes via per-connection Lucene search and/or explicit iD lists, then fetches the record and activity sections. Pull-only / read-public; OAuth2 client-credentials.

connectors.name: SharePoint
connectors.description: Microsoft SharePoint Online connector via Microsoft Graph API v1.0. Syncs Sites, Drives, DriveItems (files/folders), Lists, ListItems, ContentTypes, Columns, Permissions, and Subscriptions. Authenticates via OAuth2 Client Credentials (Azure app registr...

connectors.name: zendesk
connectors.description: Zendesk Support (Ticketing) + Help Center (Guide) connector.
